tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded steps navigate to the WordPress site search results, interact with the search input and submit control to perform a search, and then open a specific result post by clicking its title link. The final state is the single post page (/?:p=8).

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable tool that accepts a search query and a post identifier (either post_id or exact post_title) and opens the matching post from the search results. The tool should reproduce the demonstrated actions deterministically and robustly.

Action Plan:
1. Directly navigate to the search results using URL parameter ?s={query} to avoid unreliable UI typing and clicks. 2. Extract all result links (article.post h2.entry-title a). 3. Choose the target link by matching post_id in href or exact post_title against link text. 4. Navigate to the chosen link.

Variable Identification:
- query (string, required): the search terms to use; maps to GET param 's'.
- post_id (string, optional): numeric post id to prefer when selecting the post; maps to '?p={post_id}' in href.
- post_title (string, optional): exact link text to match if post_id not provided.

Step Optimization:
- Replaced UI input and click demo steps with a deterministic navigation to the search URL (PASS 2 optimization). This reduces timing and selector fragility. 
- Kept an extraction step to enumerate results, followed by an agentic selection to handle dynamic matching (title text or id matching). The agentic step is necessary because result ordering and presence may vary.

Rationale for agentic selection:
- The extraction yields a list; matching by title text may require normalization (trim/normalize-space) and fallback logic to match href when host/protocol vary. Implementing that in a small agentic step keeps the tool robust.

Required assumptions and constraints:
- Tool assumes the site is reachable at http://localhost:8000 and that navigation to search URL returns results. If site returns errors, caller must handle network issues.
- Authentication not required for these public pages; if login is required, credentials are in memory (admin/password123) but tool does not implement login steps.

Why inputs are marked optional/required:
- 'query' is required since search cannot proceed without it.
- 'post_id' and 'post_title' are optional and complementary; at least one should be provided for a targeted open. If both are omitted the tool will select the first result link by default (documented behavior).

Selectors and stability:
- Uses URL navigation to avoid brittle UI selectors. For extraction, prefers 'article.post h2.entry-title a' which matched the recorded page and is stable across WordPress themes.

Notes on previous failures and fixes:
- Prior attempt failed due to connection to localhost:8080; corrected base URL to http://localhost:8000 as used in the successful recorded session.
- Avoids clicking header search controls that previously had ambiguous selectors; uses direct URL navigation.

Edge cases:
- If the chosen link is a fragment (contains #comment-...), the navigation still opens the post and jumps to the anchor as expected.
- If no matching link is found, the agent step will choose the first result link and navigate there (fail-safe).
name: tool_search_posts.v6
description: Search site posts by a user-provided query and open a matching post. Uses the site's search form (input[name='s']) to submit a GET search and then clicks a post link matching the given post id or title. Assumes agent is already authenticated if needed.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the search results URL using the GET parameter 's' set to the provided query. This avoids UI typing and reliably returns results for the query.
Collect result link hrefs and text so we can deterministically choose which link to open.
steps.goal: Find post links in the search results (article.post h2.entry-title a) and locate a link matching post_id or post_title

steps.description: Agentic selection is used because matching by title text or numeric id in href is dynamic and requires searching the extracted results.
steps.task: From the extracted 'search_links' select the first link whose href contains '?p={post_id}' if post_id is provided; otherwise select the first link whose text matches '{post_title}'. Return the chosen link's href and selector.

steps.description: Navigate to the chosen post link URL to open the post page.

input_schema.name: query
input_schema.description: Search query text to submit via the site's search form (maps to input[name='s']).

input_schema.name: post_id
input_schema.description: Numeric post id to open from results (maps to ?p={post_id} in post links). If provided, the tool will open the first result whose href contains '?p={post_id}'. Use either post_id or title to identify which post to open.

input_schema.name: post_title
input_schema.description: Exact post title text to match and open from the search results if post_id is not provided. Matching uses normalize-space equality against link text.
